import numpy as np

from jf.geo import Frame


def test_frame_roundtrip_preserves_height_at_long_range():
    # A point about 100 km from the origin at cruise altitude.
    frame = Frame(51.0, -0.1, 0.0)
    lat, lon, h = 51.9, 1.3, 11000.0

    enu = frame.to_enu(lat, lon, h)
    lat2, lon2, h2 = frame.to_geo(enu)

    # Latitude/longitude are already fine; the bug is in height drift.
    assert np.allclose([lat2, lon2], [lat, lon], atol=1e-9)
    assert abs(h2 - h) < 1e-3
